description: This source file provides internal class and attribute definitions that facilitate compatibility with newer C# features in different .NET targets, such as .NET Standard and .NET Framework. It includes definitions for internal compiler services, nullability attributes, string extension methods, and lightweight implementations of Index and Range structs used for collection slicing support.

classes.name: IsExternalInit
classes.description: An internal static class to enable init-only setters in older .NET versions.

classes.name: MaybeNullAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a value may be null.

classes.name: MaybeNullWhenAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a parameter may be null based on return value.

classes.name: NotNullWhenAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a parameter is not null when the method returns true.

classes.name: DoesNotReturnAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a method does not return.

classes.name: DoesNotReturnIfAttribute
classes.description: Attribute for conditional method non-return behavior based on parameter.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Struct representing an index into a collection with support for from-end indexing, used for collection slicing and indexing syntax.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Struct representing a range with start and end indexes, supporting collection slicing syntax.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Extension method emulating String.Contains with StringComparison parameter for .NET Standard and Framework.

methods.name: FromStart
methods.description: Static method to create an Index from the start based on a non-negative value.

methods.name: FromEnd
methods.description: Static method to create an Index from the end.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Method to compute the offset of an Index for a collection of specified length.

methods.name: GetOffsetAndLength
methods.description: Method to compute start offset and length from a Range for a collection of specified length.
